This Aptitude doesnt have one specific theme it focuses in on, but is more focused on being used to round out other aptitudes and generally has a skill for a vast majority of playstyles
The aptitude can be found in the same places as the other common aptitudes but may be rarer to find

discordPostHtml:
Forum thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=19712.0
Download link: https://github.com/CaymonJoestar/Caymon-Ship-Pack/releases/download/V1.2.5/Caymon.Ship.Pack.zip
If you wish to tip: https://ko-fi.com/caymonjoestar
I changed way too fucking much holy shit
What was changed? Good question

NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE

Removed the XIV Remnant bounty and ships (Gonna redo it in the future to be more like sentient's fleet)
Removed Lanius/Phasehead
Phasegon,Spectre and shadow can now be found as derelicts and are removed from tri-tachyon fleets
Balance changes to the Merc Aptitude
-Some skills now have a bonus effect if the ship is officered by a Merc
-Mechcraft skill now only appears if you have arma enabled
-some buffs and nerfs to skills like raptorpack and divide and conquer

New ships:
-Wyrm: A lowtech Heavy Destroyer Mech
-Corvid: A High Tech Heavy Frigate
-Menoetius: A Converted Battle Tanker Capital
-Shocktrooper (XIV)
-Diaz (XIV) (Requires Arma to spawn)
-Rick Diaz: A lowtech Strikecraft mech (Requires Arma to spawn)
-Juggernaut: A Derelict strikecraft mech (Requires Arma to spawn)
-Incandescent: A Remnant Mobile Armor (Requires Arma to spawn)
New Sprites for the Vrita/Vic Viper/Lord British/FalchionB/Jadeknight/Luminous/Luster/Thornbill/some others I forget
New Paintjobs for vanilla lowtech: Golden Common
Whatever other changes I forgot

(Note: You need Arma 3.3.1 https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1386920618485747742/1386920618485747742)
